review_text: I did not have a great experience here. I also told her about my frustrations with Honnas over the past week and she basically responded, ok. Not what I would have expected from a practice manager. During your appointment, your husband was presented with an estimate, which he approved. All of his questions were answered at that time, and he did not express any concerns with our staff.
In an effort to be accommodating, we offered to allow you to pay for the certificate itself without scheduling another exam, as a gesture of goodwill. However, despite multiple calls from you, the required information for the health certificate was not provided, and our staff experienced repeated hostile calls. Because of the incomplete information and communication challenges, we ultimately required you to return for an appointment in order to complete the process appropriately.
When your husband arrived, much of the information we had requested from you had not been shared with him, which extended the appointment significantly — our staff spent over two hours finalizing the certificate. Although we had every right to charge an additional exam fee, we chose not to, out of fairness.
We understand that this process may have been frustrating, but please understand that our team followed the necessary protocols and worked hard to accommodate you while also ensuring all legal and medical requirements for the health certificate were met.

The staff was friendly and accommodating. The space is cute and clean. However, they didn't ask many questions or decide on a plan of care for the main concern we presented ..The biggest thing they seemed worried about was getting my pets vaccines records and getting them up to date.

Nothing was explained as far as what they would recommend or check for.. we were hoping for suggestions or an opinion of best care but it was basically just re- prescribing what we told them our last vet did.
If I didnt have another vet treat for my pets allergies I wouldnt have known what to expect treatment or cost wise but I am glad I did so I had a reference to compare. (Knowledge and price)

They do provide an estimate sheet before proceeding so it is transparent pricing as they allow you to choose what services you want to do /buy ...but the prices are almost 3x of any other vets in the area.
We did get one prescription filled just because we were already there and needed it but after seeing $70 for a $20 prescription and $50+ increase on every other item I was shocked at the pricing and will be returning to a reasonable vet.

It is convenient to go for a last minute appointment as they regularly seem to have openings same day or next day!

Again, emphasizing the staff was nice! They may be a little fresh and not yet established at providing direct care but they are helpful and answer questions as requested.

My four-year old cat stopped eating a few weeks ago—just out of the blue. To make matters worse, I had back surgery two weeks prior, and was unable to lift my cat in a carrier. I had received a mailer from Honnas Veterinary a while back and decided to call them. I spoke to a very nice person named Charley on the phone. She was terrific. I don’t live too far away, so the practice manager, Nick, came and got my cat and brought her to the office. They did blood tests and x-rays. All checked out OK. They gave me some appetite stimulates to give her and Nick drove her back to my apartment. This was on a Sunday.

I was unable to give my cat the appetite stimulates. She was having none of it. So LeBron and Zach came over and finally got some of the medicine into her. That really helped for a day or so. But her appetite still was lacking. Then they gave me a transdermal ointment to put on her ear. That did the trick. She’s now been fine for two weeks.

The staff at Honnas went far out of their way to accommodate both me with my bad back and my very difficult cat. All had incredible patience and kindness. Always picked up the phone. Always gave answers to my concerns. Plus Nick texted me every night for a week to see how my cat was getting along. Outstanding service!

I’ve been taking my various cats and dogs to vets in Austin for years. Honnas is by far the best I have ever experienced. They are a bit pricey and usually busy, but they certainly made time for me. As an added bonus, they have a payment system called Cherry, which financed my bill over 9 months with no interest and reasonable payments.

Honnas is now my go-to vet and I recommend them highly.

owner_answer: Our apologies for the confusion Mr. Hornibrook, but I think you are referring to a buzz cut. That is what’s on our website for 30 dollars . A buzz cut is just one level all around the head and some edging . I’m certain you received a haircut with more than one guard and was charged accordingly. It’s a common assumption that if any kind of haircut is done with a “buzzer” it’s a buzz cut which is not correct . The difference between a haircut and a buzz cut is the cut duration and the level of skill. Either way our apologies for the confusion. Pls look over our website again for clarification. We appreciate your feedback back and the  opportunity to address this. We also assure you this menu and terminology is consistent with all local barbershops. review_text:
I’m 38, been to a lot of barbers in my life and barbershops, but nothing is like the experience you get with the service and ambiance offered at Barber to the People. Genuinely the best environment and personalities here, you’d think you’re in a tv set or something with hilarious scripted scenes, etc. No, it’s all improv and funny as hell, but equally the service is also impeccable at the same time. A real balance of an establishment 💈.

The worst questions I always received from other barbershops: “what number of hair trimmers do you want?? 3, a 6, … maybe a 4???” Constantly scrambling to remember what I needed… With my barber, Roy, I never have to remember anything and he’s become more of a life coach than barber! He just understands what I need through intuitive conversation and genuine care for his patrons.

I’ve been seeing Roy at Barber to the People for over 2 years now. Since we developed a plan for my “look” (2 years ago) and image elevation strategy I’ve received 2 raises, 2 progressive job title changes and elevated my net worth by 20-30%. The power of a top echelon barber is more invaluable than I can possibly articulate, especially if you’re a public figure for your company,

If I could give 7 stars out of 5, I would. Also, every time I walk in to the shop (idk who the dude is that does this), but he always greets me and says farewells. No matter what. Since day 1, 2 years ago, he never fails to literally greet every single human that walks in those doors.

Incredible establishment.

Afterwards, I contacted the stylist for a refund. I cannot get a corrective cut due to observational purposes of my culture, so I knew that was not a solution viable for me, so I asked for a refund. They offered me 20$ partial refund, and 15% off my next haircut which I was not planning on using. I stated I would rather like that 15% just be applied to my refund. The makeup artist did not have the same products she used at the trial — including different lashes that looked and felt completely wrong — and after several failed attempts to change them while telling me that 'although they were not what I asked for from the day before,  but she thought they looked okay', I ended up with chunky glue all over my eyelids. We had to start over, and my sister had to leave the salon to buy lashes that more closely matched the ones from the trial that we did not even have time to apply. The artist was nice but uncommunicative and unprofessional.

To make things worse, my hair appointment wasn’t even properly booked. Red Stella mistakenly transferred my bridal hair appointment to my sister’s name as we had the same last name and nobody called me to confirm the change. As a result, my hair was rushed and was not what I had asked for when booking, likely because I received less than half the attention I was supposed to. At one point my sister begged the hair dresser to begin working with me because time was so mismanaged. We were told the entire process for both of us would take 90 minutes total, but we were there for over 3 hours.

We left Red Stella Salon over an hour later than they said that we would, missed the window to take important family photos, and had a rushed first look before guests arrived. I am now paying for editing to fix crooked, mismatched lashes and makeup that didn’t reflect the look I had asked for from the day before. Not to mention the traumatic experience and not feeling like my best self on an otherwise amazing day.

Even though I had made specific requests during the makeup trial, as basic as lip color adjustments — none of those changes were considered or applied. They did not even have the right foundation that they said they would have available for the next day right after the trial.

Every employee I spoke to during booking and in person seemed unaware of any kind of bridal protocol although they were extremely apologetic. Red Stella employees made negative comments on the quality of the makeup kit while I was there on my wedding day. When I called to share my experience afterward to ask why bridal makeup is even offered if the staff wasn't equipped-  the manager apologized and issued a refund, but she blamed staff for dropping the ball and referenced a bridal process that no one I interacted with seemed to know existed.

This was an incredibly stressful experience on a day that should have felt calm and supported. Red Stella may be fine for a haircut, but they are absolutely not equipped to handle bridal services professionally. I wouldn’t want any other bride to go through what I did. Staff was kind but extremely unprofessional, the makeup kit was poorly stocked and terribly applied (inconsistent from the trial the day before!), and management was quick to blame staff. Definitely not worth the worry, stress, and unsettling photos as a bride.

Hi Flooring Sunland, we're disappointed to see a 1-star review based on a misunderstanding of how our equipment works. Our state-of-the-art, high-efficiency Electrolux 450G washers use intelligent sensors to weigh each load and add the optimal amount of water—enough to clean and rinse thoroughly. While the water level may appear low compared to older machines, overfilling can actually REDUCE cleaning performance.

These washers also spin at 450 G-force—far higher than the 100G or 200G models at many other laundromats—removing MUCH MORE water and shortening dry times significantly, which is why clothes don’t feel as wet after the wash cycle.

We’re always available to explain how the machines work and help customers get the best possible results.

The installation and cost of the float switch were explained at the time of service and approved before work was completed.

Short version: exceptional service from Danny and Edward, knowledgeable, good pricing, great communication, quality work, good for updating wiring for EV charging.

DC picked up on the first try and got me scheduled for a walk through quickly. Until the actual install, I worked primarily with Danny. He came out for the initial visit, and as someone who works in the construction industry I felt confident that he knew his stuff. He was very patient in answering ALL of my endless questions. As someone who is cost conscious, I ran numerous scenarios to see how I could bring down the cost without sacrificing quality, and he calmly explained the pro's and con's of each option. I threw in a few extra questions, just because I enjoyed learning about the topic, and he had comprehensive answers to offer and creative solutions.

The pricing was competitive. He was able to explain the costs for each line item, and why they were what they were. They even showed me receipts of the items that were purchased to complete the work when it was completed.

After multiple estimates; once I made the decision and picked one; the work was scheduled quickly despite a busy holiday schedule for them. Danny and Edward rolled in and quickly got to work. The final product was expertly executed, and I'm happy to report that my new EV charging setup is working great! They warranty their work, but from what I see, I doubt I'll have to utilize it.

For those who like to take advantage of no-interest loans, they are available. I was able to get three months, but Danny said a new provider they are working with should take effect in 2024 that will offer up to six months. A no brainer in the inflationary, high-interest environment we're in now.

I wouldn't hesitate to call these guys in the future, and highly recommend them.

What a nightmare working with this company. To be clear, this is not about the workers who actually did the job, they were great and very professional. The real problem is the company’s administration, which is completely disorganized and unprofessional.
From the beginning, I clearly explained what needed to be fixed. They explained the fees, which were already expensive, and I agreed. They were supposed to send someone at 11:00 a.m., but instead called me at 1:30 p.m. to say the job (attaching the kitchen sink) could not be done by one person and that they would need to send two people, of course, charging more. At that point, I felt I had no choice but to accept.
When the handyman arrived, he told me that the office made the job sound much more difficult than it actually was and that it did not require two people. Since both workers were already there and the holidays were the next day, I didn’t want to send one of them away without work, so I allowed both to stay. The job was completed, I paid with a check, at that moment since of course they would not leave the house without payment, and that was the end of it…or so I thought.
A couple of weeks later, I received a text saying I needed to contact them, apparently, they were “unable to make calls” to do the payment for a service that I receive and I didn’t pay. This lady didn’t bother to ask anything, she just assumed. Again, as if were possible their crew leave the house without payment.  Their administration is a mess: they lost a check, have no clear control of client appointments, and lack basic customer service skills.
To make matters worse, the woman behind the texts was extremely rude and accusatory, acting as if I were trying to steal from her. She communicated only through demanding text messages. They charge by time, yet show no respect for their clients’ time. At one point, I softly cried, and Cam’s calm, steady breathing helped ground me. She created such a safe, compassionate space where I felt supported without needing to explain anything. Her presence was intuitive, gentle, and deeply healing.

By the end of the session, I felt lighter. The fog that had been surrounding me had lifted, and for the first time in a while, I felt at peace. I walked out feeling like everything was going to be okay.

If you are carrying stress, grief, or simply need to reconnect with yourself, Cam is a true gift. I am so grateful for her care and healing hands

name: Moonlight Head Spa | Austin
review_text:
Overall, I was disappointed with my experience. I had a 2:30 PM appointment for an 85-minute treatment, and I was informed they were running a little behind, which I completely understand happens. However, I did not get into the room until around 2:45–2:50 PM, and from that point on I felt somewhat rushed.

When my treatment ended, I was still in the process of getting dressed when the door was opened, which made me feel uncomfortable and hurried. Shortly after, another staff member came in to start cleaning while I was still finishing up and having my hair dried, which again made the experience feel rushed rather than relaxing.

I ended up walking out at 4:26 PM, and that includes time spent getting dressed, having my hair blow-dried, and using the restroom before leaving. Since I did not begin the treatment until at least 2:50 PM, it felt like I did not receive the full 85 minutes that I paid for.

I want to say that everyone was kind and professional, and I don't like leaving negative reviews. However, given the price of this service, I was disappointed that the experience felt rushed and that I may not have received the full treatment time. I hope this feedback can be helpful.

Update: The spa reached out to apologize and issued a partial refund of $60.

I was later contacted and asked to edit my review, remove mention of the refund, and increase the star rating. I initially agreed, but I am updating this again to reflect my honest experience.

review_text:
If you had told me five months ago that my favorite part of the week would involve barbells and sweat, I’d have politely suggested a career in fiction writing—or maybe a good prescription. Me? A gym person? The very idea was laughable. Exercise was a necessary evil, the chore I never actually did. And strength training? Please. I’d tried it, hated it, and assumed my body was destined to remain in the "permanently noodle-armed" category.

But then came Soho Strength Lab. Honestly, I don’t even remember why I signed up—maybe a momentary lapse in judgment, or sheer desperation—but thank goodness I did. Enter Colette, my strength-training sage and miracle worker, for 12 weeks of transformative workouts. Turns out, my body wasn’t "different"; it just needed the right guidance (and a heavy dose of accountability).

Now, not only do I willingly choose to lift weights, I enjoy it. Like, genuinely look forward to it. I’ve seen gains (actual muscles—who knew?!), learned an incredible amount, and felt better than I ever have. It's as if Soho Strength Lab tapped into some hidden version of myself—the one who thrives on grit and perseverance instead of Netflix marathons.

To Colette and the entire SSL team: thank you. You’ve turned this skeptic into a believer, and now the only prescription I’m recommending is a membership. Don’t wait five months like I did—get yourself to Soho Strength Lab. Just don’t expect me to share my favorite time slot. 😉

Buyer Beware — Cutters Landscaping Let Me Down

I’m honestly not sure how Cutters Landscaping has so many five star reviews because my experience was anything but five star. Things started off well enough, but the quality dropped fast and the disappointment just kept piling up. I hired them to install a full xeriscape design which included removing old mulch, laying compacted road base, weed barrier, and topping with crushed granite along with planting drought tolerant landscaping.

A large amount of mulch was left behind in the front flower beds, side landscaping, and other smaller areas around the house. I was told there would be a proper compacted road base followed by weed block. When I asked why there was no road base, the crew casually claimed it was mixed in with the crushed granite. That is not even close to what we discussed at the start of the project.

Then came the real corner cutting. They ran out of weed block and instead of taking the time to get more and finish the job right, they dumped crushed granite straight over mulch and dirt. I see why they are called Cutters. It is because they cut corners and hope you do not notice. When I pointed out the mulch bleeding through and that the work was clearly unfinished, I was met with attitude instead of ownership.

As a retired veteran I know the meaning of integrity and this was not it. If you are looking for a company that will actually listen to your vision and deliver with professionalism, care, and follow through, do not use Cutters. The roof at this point in time should be replaced due to it's current condition and the likelihood of additional leaks emerging soon.  I will email you soon.
